text.en: Clients consistently commend Kevin for his reassuring, pragmatic, and patient guidance during home visits and video calls. Reviewers appreciate that he answers detailed questions, explains canine body language clearly, and provides rapid answers when new puppy challenges arise.

Owners report swift and noticeable progress with biting, jumping, toilet training, and leaving puppies settled alone in rooms. Reviewers note that Kevin's straightforward techniques delivered immediate changes within an hour, helping excitable Frenchies and rescue pups become calmer.

Pet parents highlight how effectively Kevin addresses the anxieties and mouthing behaviours common in adolescent dogs and young puppies. Clients emphasize that his positive guidance builds confidence without harsh corrections, creating a peaceful dynamic with other household pets.

q.en: Does Kevin offer in-home training visits?

a.en: Yes, Kevin conducts 90-minute home visits to address behavioural issues in the dog's everyday living environment.
Reviewers highlight helpful 1-to-1 video coaching sessions via WhatsApp for quick advice on puppy routines and toilet training.

q.en: What puppy issues are commonly addressed?

a.en: Clients report rapid help with toilet training, mouthing, jumping up on guests, separation anxiety, and leash manners.

q.en: Where is the training service based?

a.en: The business is based on Long Lane in Finchley, offering home visits and classes across North London.
